description: This file implements the PackagesPage React component, which manages displaying a list of agent packages, configuring them via dialogs, and starting/stopping agents through API calls. It includes state management, event handlers, and UI rendering for package configuration and control.

methods.name: PackagesPageContent
methods.description: Main React functional component that manages the agent packages list, configuration dialogs, and start/stop actions.

methods.name: handleConfigure
methods.description: Handles the configuration process for a selected package, loading schema and current configuration.

methods.name: handleConfigurationComplete
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration after user completes the configuration wizard.

methods.name: handleCloseDialog
methods.description: Closes the configuration dialog and resets related state.
